response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the 6+ years experience requirement with nearly two decades across fullstack, backend, and systems work. Recent roles align well with the primary stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS) and he has direct AI agent development experience with MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling — a rare and explicitly required skill. Strong testing culture (TDD, test framework authorship, testing workshops) matches the quality focus of the role. Gaps are mostly secondary: no explicit Nest.js, Kotlin, or Vitest experience, and much of his frontend history is Ember rather than React.
strengths: Direct AI agent/MCP infrastructure experience, an explicitly required and uncommon skill
Deep TypeScript/Node.js fullstack experience with cloud (AWS CDK), Docker/Kubernetes, and MongoDB
Strong testing and craftsmanship background: TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, taught testing workshops
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest experience listed, both core to the primary stack
Kotlin absent and Python not listed; polyglot depth skews to niche languages like DLang
Frontend history leans heavily on Ember.js; React exposure appears limited to one recent role

key_factors.factor: TypeScript/Node fullstack depth with cloud and testing expertise
